title: The Maharashtra Animal Preservation Act, 1976.
full_text: The Maharashtra Animal Preservation Act, 1976. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 19779 Act Number: 9 Enactment Date: 1977-03-01 Act Year: 1977 Short Title: The Maharashtra Animal Preservation Act, 1976. Long Title: An Act to provide for the prohibition of slaughter 2and preservation of cows, bulls and bullocks useful for milch, breeding, draught or agricultural purposes and for restriction on slaughter for the preservation of certain other animals suitable for the said purposes. Ministry: Ministry of Govt of Maharashtra Department: Agriculture, Animal Husbandry, Dairy Development and Fisheries Department Type: STATE Location: Maharashtra Schedule 1.
